core_claim: At a fixed persistent native MLP lesion, does identical reference-answer information with lesion-specific status feedback change held-out four-way accuracy and query-time causal dependence on fixed remaining groups?
adopted_changes: Four-answer supplied nonce maps: direct lookup versus two-step composition, with a fresh per-query answer codebook; separate code-map-only guardrail.
Reference-corrected histories show identical questions and evaluator oracle answers; source predictions are private. Only 0/1 status fields vary. Demo uses equally tokenized status 2.
Two fixed lesion identities, crossed with own/other/demo/permuted histories, plus no-history baselines. No outcome-selected confirmation episodes.
Status permutation preserves early/late count, not route/error-predictive strata. Identity permutations are kept.
Lesions and recruited groups selected only on discovery, all scientific phases FP32-upcast; calibration validates fixed choices and freezes global control scaling.
Persistent primary zero masks apply to all tokens. Secondary masks apply to the query region only. Primary implementation contract uses full recomputation with use_cache=False.
Constrained four-way accuracy must improve; continuous post-softcap margins support the mechanism analysis. No margin-only behavioral recovery.
Three fixed random controls per primary lesion with calibration-only local residual-dose matching; no confirmation output-Fisher matching.
RMSNorm replay is a bounded eight-episode sensitivity analysis in an altered computation graph; not universal normalization exclusion.
Separate directional practical-effect rejection, equivalence, non-identifiability and inconclusive outcomes. No formal mediation or new-algorithm claim.
corrections_and_nonadopted_suggestions: GPT followup called 3 physical states x5 histories plus baseline 16 conditions. Three no-history physical-state baselines make 18; the plan counts all 18 explicitly.
Claude withdrew its TOST-only rejection rule and norm-to-softcap shorthand after critique.
Do not follow BF16 discovery then FP32 selection, calibration reselection, or confirmation-output-dependent Fisher matching.
Do not accept the assertion that norm replay or a route-conflict preference alone excludes every alternate mechanism or proves a new internal algorithm.
Error-profile AUC is a calibration eligibility diagnostic for one discovery-fixed visible feature/sign, not a learned controller or proof of introspection.
